accuracy_method.cach_do: runner cua du an (ivid.preprocess + ivid.postprocess dung chung) + ivid.benchmark.metrics.compute_map
accuracy_method.vi_sao_khong_dung_ultralytics_val: ultralytics.val() doi pipeline danh gia tuy theo dinh dang model, nen no do ca su khac biet cua pipeline lan cua runtime. Xem docstring ivid/benchmark/accuracy.py va results/parity_conf001.json.
accuracy_method.cong_thuc_AP: noi suy 101 diem, khop voi ultralytics compute_ap(method='interp')

accuracy_cross_check.ghi_chu: Che do khung anh cua ultralytics duoc chon cho KHOP voi duong ong: khong dem vien -> rect=False; anh 640 trong khung 672 -> imgsz=640 rect=True. So sanh nham che do se lech ~0.031 mAP@0.5 vi cau hinh chu khong vi loi — xem scripts/diag_rect.py.

memory_method: Moi cau hinh chay trong mot tien trinh rieng; con so la RSS dinh diem tru RSS luc tien trinh vua khoi dong, nen bao gom ca chi phi nap thu vien. Do chung mot tien trinh cho ca sau cau hinh se cho so cong don, khong so sanh duoc — xem docstring ivid/benchmark/memprobe.py.
